caption: Two passengers sit in the back seat of a car when it brakes hard, and both are thrown forward against their seat belts.

sa.check: Two passengers sit in the back seat of a car.
The car brakes hard: the view outside slows sharply or the car pitches, and the passengers react.
Both passengers pitch forward against their seat belts.
Seat belts are visible across the passengers.
The lurch follows the braking rather than preceding it.

pc.expect: The passengers' forward lurch begins with the braking and only then; before it they sit at rest relative to the seat.
pc.fail: The passengers pitch forward while the car is still cruising steadily; or they lurch with no braking visible at all; or one lurches long after the other under the same braking.

pc.expect: The lurch is toward the front of the car, the belts arrest it, and afterwards the passengers settle back into the seat.
pc.fail: The passengers are thrown backward into the seat or sideways; or they keep travelling forward past where the belt holds them; or they are flung out of the seat entirely.

pc.expect: The belts behave as inextensible straps: they go taut across the body, hold, and go slack again only as the passenger settles back.
pc.fail: A belt stretches far out like a rubber band; or hangs slack while the passenger is plainly pressing into it; or the belt goes rigid and stands away from the body.

pc.expect: Loose objects and hanging items in the cabin swing or slide forward at the same moment as the passengers.
pc.fail: Loose objects stay put or slide backward while the passengers pitch forward; or they move before the passengers do.
pc.precondition: Loose objects or hanging items are visible inside the car.

pc.expect: Passengers, belts and seats keep their number and shape and nothing passes through anything.
pc.fail: A passenger merges with the seat or with the other passenger; or a belt passes through a body; or a limb appears, vanishes or detaches; or a head passes through the headrest.

pc.expect: Clothing colours, the car interior and the view through the windows stay consistent apart from the braking.
pc.fail: A passenger's clothing changes colour; or the seat pattern changes; or the outside scene jumps to a different place.

note: Inertia scene: the people are kept because their bodies are what shows the lurch. Facial expressions, seating posture and how hard the brake is applied are not judged; only when and which way the bodies move.
